name: Gozo Album
author: ministryforgozoandplanning

sections.description:
Gozo Album allows you to easily display photos from the official Gozo Album – (https://gozoalbum.gov.mt) – collection on your WordPress website.

The plugin connects to the Gozo Album API and dynamically displays images in responsive layouts that integrate seamlessly with your theme. It is ideal for local councils, tourism websites, cultural organisations, and anyone who wants to showcase Gozo-related photography without manually uploading and managing images.

The plugin allows filtering by locality, category, tags, photographers, and decades.

Note: An API key is required to use this plugin. The API key must be obtained from the Gozo Album team.

Key Features

  • Display photos from the official Gozo Album collection
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly layouts
  • Image filtering options (locality, category, tags, photographers, and decade)
  • Lightweight and performance-focused
  • Compatible with most modern WordPress themes
  • No third-party gallery plugins required

Installation through the WordPress admin panel

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for Gozo Album.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Go to Settings → Gozo Album.
  6. Click on \”Settings\” then \”Gozo Album\” in the left menu.
  7. Here you can set settings such as filter to show in website front end, which are the default locality, category and items per page.
  8. Enter the API Key provided to you by the Gozo Album team.
  9. Add the shortcode [gozo_album] to a page, post, or widget.

Installation via FTP

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Unzip the plugin folder.
  3. Upload the gozo-album folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  4. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  5. Activate Gozo Album from the Plugins menu.
  6. Go to Settings → Gozo Album.
  7. Here you can set settings such as filter to show in website front end, which are the default locality, category and items per page.
  8. Enter the API Key provided to you by the Gozo Album team.
  9. Add the shortcode [gozo_album] to a page, post, or widget.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Gozo Album API to retrieve photographic content that is displayed on the website.

The external service is used to fetch photo data (such as image URLs, titles, descriptions, categories, tags, locations, and related metadata) required to render the Gozo Album galleries.

The plugin sends API requests when:
– A page containing the Gozo Album shortcode is loaded
– Cached data is refreshed automatically or manually by the site administrator

The plugin sends HTTP GET requests to the Gozo Album API endpoints to retrieve photo, tag, and photographer data.
Requests include standard HTTP headers and, if configured by the site administrator, an API key sent via request headers.

Filtering, pagination, and display logic are processed locally within the plugin and are not transmitted to the external service.

No personal data, user-generated content, IP addresses, cookies, or visitor-identifiable information are transmitted.

API Access:
To use this plugin, an API key is required. Site administrators can request an API key via the official Gozo Album API request page:
https://gozoalbum.gov.mt/api-request

The Gozo Album API is owned, operated, and maintained by the same entity that publishes this plugin (Gozo Album).

Service provider:
Gozo Album

Terms of Service:
https://www.gov.mt/en/Pages/Terms-of-use.aspx

Privacy Policy:
https://www.gov.mt/en/Pages/PrivacyPolicy.aspx
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gozo-album folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Gozo Album through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Gozo Album to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter the API key provided by the Gozo Album team.
  5. Use the shortcode [gozo_album] in a post, page, or widget to display the photos.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, you need to obtain the API key from the Gozo Album team. You can request one from https://gozoalbum.gov.mt/api-request or contact us by email on gozoalbum@gov.mt.

How do I display the photos on my website?

Photos are displayed using the [gozo_album] shortcode. You can insert this shortcode into any page, post, or widget to display the photos. Upon plugin installation, you can configure this shortcode within a Gozo Album menu item that you can find under the Settings menu item.

Can I filter which photos are displayed?

Yes. The plugin settings allow you to configure filters such as localities, categories, and other parameters that control which photos are displayed on the front end.

Can I style the gallery?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress standards and can be styled using your theme’s CSS.
